{{Otheruses|jewel}}
'''Seafah jewels''' were found on the ocean floors of [[Pydyr]]. They were very valuable, and decorated the insides of most buildings on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. Because it was so hard to find them&mdash;as it took a skilled eye to see them&mdash;the natives of Pydyr attempted to build [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to find them. The droids were a failure, as they usually picked up centuries of hardened [[Fish/Legends|fish]] dung.
